title: tuberaria vulgaris f. alpestris
intro: Tuberaria vulgaris f. alpestris, commonly known as Mountain Tuberaria, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. It is known for its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it beneficial for various health conditions. The plant is said to have therapeutic actions such as wound healing, anti-anxiety, and antispasmodic effects, and its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic applications.
